question: Who is the author of the historical novel ‘Twilight in Delhi’?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Ahmed Ali__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ahmed Ali was a Pakistani novelist,** poet, critic, translator, diplomat, and scholar.
 
• The novel is also about the **domestic life of Muslims.**
 
• Twilight in Delhi is Ahmed Ali's **first novel.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Amrita Pritam** was an Indian novelist, essayist, and poet, who wrote in Punjabi and Hindi. Amrita Pritam is most remembered for her poignant poem** "Ajj Aakhaan Waris Shah Nu".**
 
• **Khushwant Singh** was an Indian author, lawyer, diplomat, journalist, and politician. The most popular novel written by Khushwant Singh is **"Train to Pakistan".**
 
• **Krishna Sobti** was an Indian Hindi-language fiction writer and essayist.** Zindaginama is written by Krishna Sobti.**
